findings.title: City of Wymore seeks residents’ input after last grocery store closes
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Their last grocery store, Wymore Super Foods, is closing, causing the City to take action.
findings.summary: A local report published on October 27 says Wymore, Nebraska, no longer has a grocery store following the loss/closure of its last store, Wymore Super Foods. The city has reportedly formed a steering group and is surveying Wymore and southern Gage County residents about restoring grocery access, delivery partnerships, or a community-owned cooperative. The exact closure date and present operating status of the store are not consistently expressed in the report ('has no grocery store' versus 'is closing'); editorial review should confirm timing with the city before publication. Reporting surfaced as newly published within this watch window; underlying closure date remains unverified.
findings.scope: Loss of community's last grocery store; Wymore citywide grocery access, with southern Gage County consultation
affected_groups: Southern Gage County residents potentially relying on Wymore for food access (extent unquantified)

coverage_notes: Supplementary high-value-miss recall only. The nationwide production collector remains authoritative and was neither queried nor modified.
Twelve targeted fresh-web searches completed; four classes covered. One qualifying newly reported last-grocery-store access loss in Wymore, Nebraska.

KLKN published on October 27 and displays a relative publication age but no stable exact timestamp; source_published_at preserves day precision. The exact date the grocery store closed is not established by the report, and the article ambiguously uses 'is closing' while also saying Wymore has no grocery store.

KLKN quotes city action to form a steering group and solicit residents' views. The full local article was accessible via web retrieval, but an optional direct-origin metadata fetch from the execution container failed because DNS resolution was unavailable; status is DEGRADED conservatively under the source-retrieval failure rule. This did not prevent verification of the article text.

The previously recorded October 26 Utah Heber City pantry closure/Provo access reduction was excluded as a duplicate. Kansas City Sun Fresh Blue Parkway closed October 25; no evidence established it as the community's only/last/full-service grocery store, and it predates the interval.

Searches yielded no new verified disaster-canceled food distribution, abrupt pantry/food-bank closure, or official SNAP/WIC benefits interruption during this observation interval. Hurricane Lowell recovery distribution expansion is not a cancellation; most SNAP interruption hits related to October/November 2025.

Search indexing and publication delays limit negative assurance. The new Wymore item is pending human editorial review and not claimed unduplicated against the authoritative nationwide production collector.
